rationale: The observations measure aggregate end-to-end delay at one operating point, without resolving internal stages or uniquely identifying an internal cause. They provide no observations at other operating points, and the settled three-hour delay directly excludes zero remaining delay. The repeated reversible effect supports the tested intervention without overcoming these limits.

signal_basis.exact_text: Process P-17 runs at the stated operating point. The tested input is a bounded increase in its intake-priority setting.

The measured output is end-to-end delay in hours. Each of three repetitions settles from five hours to three hours after the step and returns to five hours after reversal. No other input changes or disturbances occur during these observations.
